comments.value:
I'm on the fence about this one, if you included Group and Group Public in the list of excluded types, I might have been swayed - But that's been omitted as a thinly veiled attempt to gain moderation control over Group Public lobbies. (Which creates a ton of headaches for the VR events community)

That aside, I'm not convinced this is a good idea in general simply because I know that this will lead to world creators (Who are not experienced in Trust and Safety) being expected to handle contentious issues / witch-hunts that they never envisioned handling, and are ill-prepared to handle. 

The consequences of (readily foreseeable) poor handling of those issues, in the context of indefinite public world bans that may be shared with other world creators (e.g. United Moderation) possibly outweighs the benefit.

@{618fa6ccbfca2a69d13f829c|full_name}, I understand the concern, this is an idea. I would love to hear feedback to improve it. 

I love to watch groups grow their communities within my worlds.

Also, I forgot to add Group Publics to the post. 

Me being apart of multiple great events communities I understand that events are a large part of VRChat. 

It shouldn't be labeled as a world moderation, more of a protection for larger creators like myself. (To mitigate Harassment)

That's why I believe they should still have access to non Public instances and group instances. 

Note: Anything you add can be abused. 

Example: Groups gave random people the power to make something.  

Within those group public instances you could be kicked for outlandish things.

- Not being 18+, Or not having your age in your bio.

- Not being a Furry and being a Furry.

- Sounding young.

- And so many more.

You are right that some users might feel obligated to "Moderate" their worlds. But, They aren't obligated to create a community they would like to protect.

I simply ask for the ability to stop users from hurting my community.

Brainstorm, think of ways to keep communities like mine and others safe.

Have a goodnight- Shadow.

There's always more to explain~
What would stop bad actors from making a new account every time they get blocked from a public world?
You could ask the same for Vrchat bans, It'll get boring for users to continuously make new accounts after the 3rd account.

I fully agree with this.

We as users should really have the ability to moderate better.

The only thing stopping us is VRChat's strict rules on specifically world moderation.

Giving us some more wiggle-room, and letting us actually use our full potential when needed can and would save so many headaches, both for world moderators, but also for the users who we're here to protect.

Giving us more freedom in how we are able to get rid of bad actors would severely impact both workflow and QOL positively.

@{5ea09825205c8653c54c92c7|full_name} But as stated in the OP, they'll just make new accounts... so...

And keeping in mind, this feature is being suggested as a workaround to reporting to VRChat. This means that Accounts that would have otherwise been removed from the platform, had they been reported Trust and Safety, will just go troll other worlds instead, and only when they've been banned by enough creators will they need to make a new account. (IE: Less accounts needed overall, more disruption to the platform.)

@{618fa6ccbfca2a69d13f829c|full_name} As mentioned, this is for protection relating to users that continually harass the content creator. 

Suggestions (would like to see a system were when you report a user you can get a pop up message that will allow you to block them from your content. After you make a report.)

Throw your ideas out there.

@{630e721b772f1844c73d8664|full_name} Well then this is just a subjective non-starter. Blocking people from your worlds is not going to stop them 'harassing' / 'slandering' you as a Creator, because Furry Hideout is not a prison. (Users are free to come and go as they wish, and you can be 'slandered' anywhere, even if you ban people from your own worlds.)

Honestly, this idea seems to be born out of a deeply personal matter, and I'm not at all convinced that it's not going to be used in vindictive and stupid ways, which is the one of the reasons why I'd be very concerned about anything like this.

@{630e721b772f1844c73d8664|full_name} At least when VRChat bans someone, it bans them from the platform and saves other creators the trouble of dealing with that account. World bans as you have proposed, would leave the account in place so the user can go harass other creators, furry worlds or whatever.

@{630e721b772f1844c73d8664|full_name} "It shouldn't be labeled as a world moderation, more of a protection for larger creators like myself. (To mitigate Harassment)"

Let's call it what it is and have an honest conversation yeah?

You are talking about world creator / moderator bans. You want the ability to permanently ban people from your worlds, and you know that you and other creators will be able to use that power in any way you wish if it is granted. You haven't proposed any constraints on this power except restricting it to certain instance types.

@{618fa6ccbfca2a69d13f829c|full_name} As mentioned what would you do to combat these issues? 

As mentioned suggest and create ways that work for everyone. 

You seem to have a lot of input, put it to work and make something better.

@{630e721b772f1844c73d8664|full_name} I'm not entirely sure because I don't have the specifics of the problem you're hoping to solve with this. Evidently there is a catalyst for you requesting this, perhaps you can enlighten everyone and share and then we can discuss how one might resolve it. Thus far all you've said is 'harassment', 'slander' and 'crashing' and you're suggesting in your OP that people are already creating accounts to get around the bans that VRChat does, so part of me is wondering how this will be any different
It definitely could be used that way, stand in a creators shoe's. You'll be hurtin for some good support.

@{618fa6ccbfca2a69d13f829c|full_name}, with VRChats systems now, reporting users doesn't always work especially with users that are Extreme Harassers.

Groups, themselves have a "Block/Ban" function. Which bars bad actors from group related worlds and protects the group. (Without reporting them to other communities.)

I offer something that VRChat basically already offers. 

I deal with usually the same users over and over again.

Some that have 20+ Accounts, some I can report and get banned from VRChat for tos violations. (Client users) Some are a lot more difficult.

If you would like to contact me more and brain storm feel free to contact me through VRChat.

@{630e721b772f1844c73d8664|full_name} Can you please define "Extreme Harassment"?

It's important to remember that VRChat just modified their Terms of Service to allow for upcoming in-game reporting features that include automatically including a buffer with reports etc, amongst other things... So this is already expected to get infinitely better in the near term.

That aside, Group Bans do not have the scale of impact that receiving a World Creator ban would entail, which is why I view this as a false equivalence. Obviously, there are a LOT more Public instances than Group Public instances, and being banned from all Public instances for a particular creator has a much much greater potential to negatively impact a user's overall VRChat experience.

@{618fa6ccbfca2a69d13f829c|full_name} Extreme Harassment being when someone has an unhealthy need to attack me or my community. 

Normal Harassment, 

(Someone calling me the N-Word multiple times)

Extreme Harassment, 

(Someone making 10 accounts to all sing, Shadow is a Ni***r) usually bots.

People taking photos of me at fur-cons to threaten me.

Sending me those photos with fucked up captions. 

Etc I've seen a lot.

@{630e721b772f1844c73d8664|full_name} Alright, well, I'm of the opinion that being able to block people from your worlds isn't going to help with your definition of 'Extreme Harassment' - You've already noted most of this is occurring outside VRChat, and that the behaviour which is occurring inside VRChat is A) Specifically targeted at you, not world creators in general B) Already involves a plethora of alt accounts, meaning blocking accounts from worlds isn't going to help much.

@{630e721b772f1844c73d8664|full_name} In my experience, some creators get far more attention than others. I've never worked out why, but I'd probably aim to be one of the ones that don't get hate train-ed

If you don't want certain people in your instance, make a VRChat Group that you can moderate however you please and use Group Public instances. That way you can keep whoever you want out of your instances by banning them from your VRChat Group.

The [creator guidelines](https://hello.vrchat.com/creator-guidelines) states you aren't allowed to automatically blacklist people from your worlds, and your suggestion would basically be the same thing. To the best of my knowledge, Public instances are supposed to be unmoderated and open to all.

It sounds like you need to work on being better at self-moderating, such as muting or blocking troublemakers, starting a vote-to-kick if they are being a nuisance to everyone, and even leaving instances that make you uncomfortable.

If someone is harassing you that much in VRChat, you need to report them to VRChat. If the harassment continues even after the bad actors were banned, then tell VRChat again and they can punish them more if needed. For example, only VRChat would be able to actually IP-ban someone from the platform, which would then require bad actors to use expensive VPNs to continue. What VRChat has for legal actions they can take if people are openly bypassing account bans and IP-bans is something only VRChat can answer, but giving you the ability to punish people instead wouldn't give VRChat that option.

If the harassment extents beyond VRChat and even into threats, then consider contacting your local law enforcement about the issue.

details:
Good evening, I propose a feature to mitigate harassment of larger world creators and smaller content creators.

-Blocks that disallow use of the creators public worlds, this will allow us to remove bad actors that continuously "Slander, Crash, Harass, and more". 

-This Block shouldn't completely bar access to the world completely, use of group +, Friends+, Friends, Invite +, Invite Only, should be accessible.

Notes- Reports are the way to go, But with larger creators it's really hard to report users over and over again. I thank trust and safety for all they do, But bad actors can always make new accounts faster than I can report them with proper evidence. 

Being proactive and being able to mitigate abuse of users will make our lives easier.
title: [Feature Request] Better block moderation
